response.sql:
WITH equipment_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    equipref,
    AVG(humepct) as eq_avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
all_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(eq_avg_humidity) as overall_avg
  FROM equipment_avg
),
kept_equipment AS (
  SELECT 
    ea.equipref,
    ea.eq_avg_humidity,
    aa.overall_avg
  FROM equipment_avg ea
  CROSS JOIN all_avg aa
  WHERE aa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.eq_avg_humidity > aa.overall_avg
),
kept_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(eq_avg_humidity) as kept_mean
  FROM kept_equipment
),
final_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ke.equipref,
    ROUND(ke.eq_avg_humidity, 2) as avg_humidity,
    ROUND(ke.eq_avg_humidity - ke.overall_avg, 2) as exceeds_overall,
    ROUND(ABS(ke.eq_avg_humidity - ks.kept_mean), 2) as diff_from_kept_mean
  FROM kept_equipment ke
  CROSS JOIN kept_stats ks
),
with_row_number AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 
      CASE WHEN diff_from_kept_mean IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
      diff_from_kept_mean DESC) as rn
  FROM final_data
)
SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, exceeds_overall, diff_from_kept_mean
FROM with_row_number
WHERE rn <= 10 
  OR (COALESCE(CAST(diff_from_kept_mean AS TEXT), 'NULL') = 
      COALESCE((SELECT CAST(diff_from_kept_mean AS TEXT) FROM with_row_number WHERE rn = 10 LIMIT 1), 'NULL'))
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN diff_from_kept_mean IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
  diff_from_kept_mean DESC;

assumptions.assumption: "Return nothing if either reference average is missing" means: skip equipment with no humidity readings and return empty result if no equipment remain after filtering for those above the all-equipment average.
"How far it is from the mean humidity of just the kept equipment" means the absolute difference between each kept equipment's average and the mean of all kept equipment averages.
"Top 10 plus any further rows that tie with the 10th" means: include all rows where diff_from_kept_mean equals the 10th row's value, whether or not there are additional rows beyond 10.
